# v0.39.0 - 2026-11-20

### Added

- **Hold the green button 5 s to refresh now (#280, #282).** A config edit used to reach the panel only at the next scheduled wake, up to 8 h away. Holding green for 5 s now makes the device join Wi-Fi and fetch its frames unconditionally (no `If-Modified-Since`, so the server can't answer 304), then store and redraw. A shorter press still flips orientation, now acted on at release, and the two-white factory reset is unchanged. A failed forced pull keeps the stored validator, so later wakes stay conditional. A button that is still held, or stuck, is left out of the wake sources for that sleep instead of waking the device in a loop, and the sleep is capped at 5 min so the button re-arms soon after release. Bench-verified on the reTerminal E1001: a tap flips with no fetch, a 5 s hold fetches and redraws, and a 20 s hold fetches once and sleeps.

### Fixed

- **The editor could send the deferred 920×680 panel size to an 800×480 device (#283, #285).** The display profile was restored from browser storage and also set the width/height saved to the device. After one preview of the 5.76" panel, every later visit started on it and every save told the reTerminal to render 920×680, which it rejects. It then kept showing the setup screen. The editor now always starts on the reTerminal E1001, and saves and JSON exports always carry the device target's size. Picking another profile changes only the preview, for the rest of the session.
